title: Mirror World
description: See your wonderful worlds from a whole new angle! A unique challenge featuring screen and control inversion.
body:
🪞 Mirror World

Have you ever wondered how well you actually know your Minecraft world? Mirror World offers a unique experience: look at familiar builds and landscapes from a completely different perspective—literally!

This lightweight mod for Fabric allows you to mirror the game's perspective, turning ordinary survival into a true test for your brain and muscle memory.
✨ Features

    Horizontal Mirroring: Left becomes right, and right becomes left. Perfect for confusing your instincts!

    Vertical Mirroring: Feel like you're in Australia by turning the world upside down.

    Hand Compatibility: Items in your hands are displayed correctly, maintaining the immersion.

🎮 Commands

Toggle modes directly in-game using simple commands:

    /mirrormode horizontal — Enable horizontal mirroring.

    /mirrormode vertical — Enable vertical mirroring.

    /mirrormode off — Return to the normal view.
